<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  
  <!-- status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="28" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="20" y="18" font-family="Poppins" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
  <line x1="320" y1="17" x2="320" y2="13" stroke="#231F20" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="324" y1="17" x2="324" y2="11" stroke="#231F20" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="328" y1="17" x2="328" y2="9" stroke="#231F20" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="332" y1="17" x2="332" y2="7" stroke="#231F20" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="346" cy="13" r="2.2" fill="#231F20"/>
  <line x1="341" y1="15" x2="351" y2="15" stroke="#231F20" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="362" y="8" width="20" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#231F20" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="364" y="10" width="15" height="7" rx="1" fill="#231F20"/>
  <rect x="383" y="11" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#231F20"/>

  <!-- home hero -->
  <rect x="0" y="28" width="390" height="205" fill="#0378FFD9"/>
  <text x="22" y="74" font-family="Pompiere" font-size="25px" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">Yepty</text>
  <circle cx="334" cy="65" r="16" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.25"/>
  <circle cx="331" cy="62" r="5.5" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  <line x1="335" y1="66" x2="340" y2="71" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  <circle cx="370" cy="65" r="16" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.25"/>
  <line x1="364" y1="65" x2="376" y2="65" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="370" y1="59" x2="370" y2="71" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  
  <text x="22" y="126" font-family="Poppins" font-size="20px" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">A place for writers.</text>
  <text x="22" y="151" font-family="Poppins" font-size="12px" font-weight="300" fill="#FFFFFF">Read something beautiful today.</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="22" y="174" width="142" height="34" rx="17" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="93" y="196" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="12px" font-weight="500" fill="#516DFF">Explore writing</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="174" y="174" width="104" height="34" rx="17" fill="#00000033"/>
    <text x="226" y="196" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="12px" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Share a line</text>
  </g>

  <!-- feed header -->
  <rect x="0" y="233" width="390" height="52" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="20" y="264" font-family="Poppins" font-size="15px" font-weight="500" fill="#000000">Your feed</text>
  <text x="306" y="264" font-family="Poppins" font-size="12px" font-weight="400" fill="#516DFF">See all</text>
  <line x1="20" y1="284" x2="370" y2="284" stroke="#00000033" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- post one -->
  <g>
    <rect x="19" y="298" width="352" height="116" rx="5" fill="#00000033"/>
    <rect x="18" y="296" width="352" height="116" rx="5" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <circle cx="326" cy="316" r="17" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.25"/>
    <polygon points="309,390 326,369 338,382 349,373 362,390" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.42"/>
    <circle cx="348" cy="312" r="5" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.65"/>
    <text x="32" y="326" font-family="Poppins" font-size="12px" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Maya Ellison</text>
    <text x="32" y="351" font-family="Poppins" font-size="15px" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">The quiet between words</text>
    <text x="32" y="372" font-family="Poppins" font-size="10px" font-weight="300" fill="#FFFFFF">“Some silences know exactly what they mean.”</text>
    <text x="32" y="397" font-family="Poppins" font-size="10px" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">2 min read  ·  148 appreciations</text>
  </g>

  <!-- post two -->
  <g>
    <rect x="19" y="428" width="352" height="116" rx="5" fill="#00000033"/>
    <rect x="18" y="426" width="352" height="116" rx="5" fill="#231F20B2"/>
    <circle cx="326" cy="446" r="17" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.15"/>
    <polygon points="307,520 326,491 339,506 351,484 366,520" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.28"/>
    <circle cx="348" cy="442" r="5" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.55"/>
    <text x="32" y="456" font-family="Poppins" font-size="12px" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Jon Bell</text>
    <text x="32" y="481" font-family="Poppins" font-size="15px" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Postcards from a rainy city</text>
    <text x="32" y="502" font-family="Poppins" font-size="10px" font-weight="300" fill="#FFFFFF">A small collection of places I almost stayed.</text>
    <text x="32" y="527" font-family="Poppins" font-size="10px" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">4 min read  ·  92 appreciations</text>
  </g>

  <!-- post three -->
  <g>
    <rect x="19" y="558" width="352" height="116" rx="5" fill="#00000033"/>
    <rect x="18" y="556" width="352" height="116" rx="5" fill="#D9D9D94D"/>
    <circle cx="326" cy="576" r="17" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.4"/>
    <polygon points="307,650 322,628 334,638 346,618 365,650" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.55"/>
    <circle cx="348" cy="572" r="5" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.8"/>
    <text x="32" y="586" font-family="Poppins" font-size="12px" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Priya Nair</text>
    <text x="32" y="611" font-family="Poppins" font-size="15px" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Instructions for becoming soft</text>
    <text x="32" y="632" font-family="Poppins" font-size="10px" font-weight="300" fill="#FFFFFF">Keep the window open. Let the morning in.</text>
    <text x="32" y="657" font-family="Poppins" font-size="10px" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">3 min read  ·  231 appreciations</text>
  </g>

  <!-- post four partial but populated -->
  <g>
    <rect x="19" y="688" width="352" height="76" rx="5" fill="#00000033"/>
    <rect x="18" y="686" width="352" height="76" rx="5" fill="#231F20CC"/>
    <text x="32" y="711" font-family="Poppins" font-size="12px" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Theo Martins</text>
    <text x="32" y="736" font-family="Poppins" font-size="15px" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">A letter to my future self</text>
    <text x="32" y="754" font-family="Poppins" font-size="10px" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">6 min read  ·  67 appreciations</text>
  </g>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="775" width="390" height="69" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="775" x2="390" y2="775" stroke="#00000033" stroke-width="1"/>
  
  <!-- home -->
  <g>
    <polygon points="27,799 36,792 45,799 45,811 28,811" fill="#516DFF"/>
    <polygon points="25,800 36,790 47,800" fill="none" stroke="#516DFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="36" y="831" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="10px" font-weight="500" fill="#516DFF">Home</text>
  </g>
  <!-- messages -->
  <g>
    <rect x="103" y="792" width="22" height="16" rx="5" fill="none" stroke="#231F2099" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polygon points="107,808 107,812 113,808" fill="#231F2099"/>
    <circle cx="109" cy="800" r="1.4" fill="#231F2099"/>
    <circle cx="114" cy="800" r="1.4" fill="#231F2099"/>
    <circle cx="119" cy="800" r="1.4" fill="#231F2099"/>
    <text x="114" y="831" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="10px" font-weight="400" fill="#231F2099">Messages</text>
  </g>
  <!-- create -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="195" cy="801" r="18" fill="#516DFF"/>
    <line x1="188" y1="801" x2="202" y2="801" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="195" y1="794" x2="195" y2="808" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="195" y="831" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="10px" font-weight="400" fill="#231F2099">Create</text>
  </g>
  <!-- people -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="267" cy="797" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#231F2099" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="267" cy="808" rx="9" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#231F2099" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="278" cy="799" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#231F2099" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="267" y="831" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="10px" font-weight="400" fill="#231F2099">People</text>
  </g>
  <!-- profile -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="347" cy="798" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#231F2099" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="347" cy="809" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#231F2099" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="347" y="831" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="10px" font-weight="400" fill="#231F2099">Profile</text>
  </g>
</svg>
